name: Fake cloud billing, image bake and worker lifecycle
target: Replay cut-pinned golden image baking, cloud registry propagation, role-tagged VM admission, monthly cost reservations, worker scaling and cut-to-verify release gating without provider access.
inputs: host role, image, credentials, substitutions and mirror freshness
monthly budget, hourly rate and runtime reservation
training worker demand and release phase
observations: image digest pinned to cut SHA and recipe
image download and partial recipe failures
credential, substitution, mirror, role, cut and deadline refusals
warmup preemption and fallback host selection
budget reservations, runtime spend and remaining balance
train worker scale up, idle scale down, gate slot reclamation and restoration
cut, gate, publish and verify phase transitions
zero human intervention and zero external calls
